question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hardly**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "There was _____ a pair of boots in the town and in the country for many miles _____ that had not once or twice passed _____ his hands" indicates that almost every pair of boots had passed through his hands.
 
• "Hardly" means almost no or almost none, which fits the context of conveying that very few boots *hadn't* been touched by him.
 
• "Besides" means in addition to or apart from, which doesn't fit the quantity description.
 
• "Always" means at all times, which would imply *all* boots had passed through his hands, which is a stronger and less probable claim than "hardly any hadn't."
 
• "Now" refers to the present time, which is irrelevant here.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *There lived in a town in Russia a bootmaker named Martin. He lived in a small room, half sunk 1. below__ the level of the street, with one window which 2. __opened__ on the street. He had lived in the same room for many years and knew many people. There was 3. __hardly__ a pair of boots in the town and in the country for many miles 4. **_________**that had not once or twice passed 5. **_________**his hands.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Besides (के अतिरिक्त): In addition to; apart from.
 
• Always (हमेशा): At all times; on all occasions.
 
• Now (अब): At the present time or moment.
